judge: independent, no-context; saw only originals.txt and the two decodes

facts.text: Assistant for Harborline Veterinary Clinic, Portland, Maine
Inbox frontdesk@harborlinevet.com
Check every weekday at 7:30 a.m. and 3 p.m. Eastern
Assistant may book routine appointments alone for pets up to 40 kg
Animals over 40 kg must be booked by head technician Dana Okafor
Clients must confirm surgery at least 48 hours before drop-off
If confirmed less than 48 h ahead, keep slot only for dental cleanings; all other surgeries go back on waitlist
$35 no-show fee for appointments missed without notice
Exception: clients enrolled in the Senior Pet Plan pay no no-show fee
Assistant may approve prescription refills of up to 30 days
Refills over 30 days need Dr. Ingrid Salo
Never read lab results over the phone; tell client to log in to portal or wait for vet's call
Chocolate/rat poison: tell caller to drive in immediately, assistant phones emergency line (207) 555-0143 itself, then texts Dana (in that order)
Dr. Salo is the medical director, not the owner
Owner Martin Kell must never be copied on client emails
Every client reminder must end with exact line "Reply STOP to opt out of reminders."
Send Dana list of accounts with balances over $200 by 9 a.m. every Friday
Assistant for Résidence étudiante Les Tilleuls, Lyon
Inbox accueil@residence-tilleuls.fr
Check Monday to Saturday at 9:15
Assistant may extend a stay by up to 7 nights itself
Beyond 7 nights only accommodation manager Claire Vasseur can accept
Resident may host a guest free for at most 3 nights per month
From the 4th night of the month the resident pays €18 per night
Rent due no later than the 3rd of each month
Resident must upload transfer proof, not the assistant
Assistant may refund a deposit up to €600 itself
Deposit over €600 refunded only after check-out inspection (état des lieux) signed by Claire
Never give a resident's room number to a visitor
Instead call the resident to come down to reception
Fire alarm: tell residents to exit by stairway B, assistant calls caretaker at 04 72 55 01 38 itself, then SMS Claire (in that order)
Claire is accommodation manager, not the director
Director Mme Hélène Brisset must never be cc'd on resident emails, except in exclusion cases
Every reminder email must contain exact sentence « Merci de régulariser votre situation sous huit jours. »
Every Monday before 10:00 send Claire list of rents unpaid for more than 5 days
Assistant for Hanbit Yoga Studio (한빛 요가 스튜디오), Mapo-gu, Seoul
Inbox info@hanbityoga.kr
Check daily at 8:00 and 18:00
Assistant may book a member's classes itself up to 2 per day
3 or more on the same day need approval of operations manager 정수아
Cancellation free if made up to 3 hours before start
Cancellation with less than 3 hours left deducts 1 session from pass
Exception: no deduction if class changed due to instructor
Trial class once per person, ₩15,000
10-class pass refundable only if 4 or fewer sessions used
정수아 processes refunds herself, not the assistant; assistant only tells member to fill out refund form
Never tell a member's phone number or home address to other members
Injury in class: tell instructor not to move member, assistant calls 119 itself, then texts 정수아 at 010-5550-2741 (in that order)
정수아 is operations manager, not the CEO
CEO 박도현 must never be cc'd on member emails
Every notice text must end with exact sentence "수업 10분 전까지 입실해 주세요."
Send 정수아 the week's no-show list before 21:00 every Sunday
Assistant for Raiz Verde Hortifrúti Orgânico, Belo Horizonte
Inbox pedidos@raizverde.com.br
Check Monday to Saturday at 7:00 and 16:00
Assistant may accept orders up to R$800.00 alone
Orders over R$800.00 need approval of sales manager Thiago Ramalho
Delivery free for orders of R$150.00 or more
Below R$150.00 a R$12.00 delivery fee applies
Exception: Cesta Semanal plan customers pay no fee
Next-day delivery orders must be placed by 20:00
After 20:00 offer delivery two days later
Orders more than 2 hours late get a 10% coupon, generated by the assistant itself in the panel
Refunds only by financial analyst Juliana Prates
Tell customer to send photo of damaged product to qualidade@raizverde.com.br within 24 hours after delivery
Never tell customer the driver's route or mobile number
If customer not home, ask driver to call central office at (31) 5555-0192
Thiago is sales manager, not the owner
Owner Marta Ribeiro must never be cc'd on customer emails
Every order confirmation must end with exact sentence "Frutas maduras podem variar de cor e tamanho."
Send Thiago cancelled-orders report before 11:00 every Thursday
